name: Custom Tabs
description: Add custom tabs to the horizontal bar at the top of the Jellyfin web client, e.g. for a "Requests" tab. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Add custom tabs to the top navigation bar of the Jellyfin web client

versions.changelog: Personal JF12 patch (unofficial): retarget to net10.0 and bump Jellyfin.Common/Jellyfin.Model/Jellyfin.Controller/Jellyfin.Data to 12.0.0. Added a JellyfinVersionSpecific/12.0 startup-trigger helper (reused from the existing 10.11 implementation, which already used the modern enum-based TaskTriggerInfoType API). No functional changes vs upstream 0.2.0.0. Build-verified only, not yet tested against a live JF12 server.

name: Editor's Choice
description: Adds a full-width slider to the Jellyfin web UI home page to feature selected content, similar to the Netflix home page. Featured content is drawn from a user's favourites or a random/filtered selection.
overview: Featured-content slider for the Jellyfin web UI home page

versions.changelog: Personal JF12 patch (unofficial): retarget to net10.0 and bump Jellyfin.Controller/Jellyfin.Model/Jellyfin.Common to 12.0.0. No source changes were needed — built clean on the first try, 0 errors, 0 warnings. No functional changes vs upstream 1.5.2. Build-verified only, not yet tested against a live JF12 server.

name: Skin Manager
description: Download and install skins for the Jellyfin web client from a catalog of community-made skins.
overview: Download and install skins for the Jellyfin web client

versions.changelog: Personal JF12 patch (unofficial): retarget to net10.0 and bump Jellyfin.Controller to 12.0.0 (Jellyfin.Model comes in transitively). No source changes needed - built clean, 0 errors. One pre-existing warning (MSB3245, unrelated to this patch): the csproj has a dead <Reference Include="MediaBrowser.Api"> pointing at a hardcoded Windows path from the original author's machine; it is not used anywhere in the plugin's code, left as-is since it's a warning not an error. Also corrected this plugin's build.yaml, which had been stale and wrong since the repo's first commit in 2020 (it described an unrelated plugin, wrong guid, wrong framework) - see docs/STATUS.md and CLAUDE.md. GUID unchanged, sourced from Plugin.cs (ground truth), not from the old build.yaml. Build-verified only, not yet tested against a live JF12 server.
